selections.title: Auto MDI/MDIX defaults
selections.justification: Primary match - covers default polarity handling

selections.title: Port Auto MDI/MDIX
selections.justification: Direct Zephyr cross-ref for objective shape

step4.objective:
• The port with no pluggable defaults to automatic MDI/MDIX polarity handling.
  • Inserting a supported pluggable resolves polarity and establishes link.
  • A port configured for Auto speed and duplex establishes a link with a compliant partner.
  • The port accurately reports Auto mode together with the negotiated speed and duplex values.

steps.description: The testing for this is covered by related ART / Zephyr cases linked in Traceability.
Verify default behavior with no pluggable (auto polarity).
Insert pluggable and confirm link and reporting.
Test with straight and crossover cables.
Verify status reporting after link establishment.
